agency: Wisconsin Department of Transportation Division of Highways
summary: The agency noted that right-of-way negotiations and acquisition were halted pending completion and approval of the Final EIS, and indicated that the School Board's interest in the undeveloped Parnell Avenue parcels would be investigated by the Division of Highways.
text:
Right of way negotiations and acquisition were stopped in March 1973 until this Final EIS is completed and approved.
The City of Milwaukee School Board has expressed interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for the land taken from Hamlin-Garland School. This will be investigated by the Division of Highways.
